# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ Utility to safely render a blog post for display. """ import html from typing import Final # Example format: you can adjust the template to match your HTML structure. BLOG_FORMAT: Final[str] = """

{title}

{body}
""" def show_blog_post(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Return a sanitized and formatted blog post ready for safe display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title of the blog post. text : str The main content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and formatted HTML snippet. """ # Escape special characters to prevent XSS attacks safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Format the sanitized content into the predefined template return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
